back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Doctors warn that overprescribing antibiotics is not only accelerating the development of drug-resistant bacteria but also disrupting the delicate microbial balance in the human gut.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："not only A but also B" = 递进并列，两项危害均为答案。② 核心规律：CET6 专家警告 + 双重危害：not only...but also = 两点均要在答案中体现。③ 验证与迁移：答案应覆盖两项：drug resistance + gut microbiome disruption；只覆盖一项的选项不完整。
tips: not only A but also B = 并列递进，A 和 B 都是答案，不可只选一项。
delicate microbial balance = 肠道微生态，是 CET6 健康类高频概念。

front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再说出首席医疗官的具体建议及其原因。

back_content.text: 结论：建议：即使症状改善也应完成全程抗生素治疗；原因：防止部分治疗耐药性产生。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The Chief Medical Officer emphasized that patients should complete the full prescribed course of antibiotics, even if symptoms improve after a few days, to prevent partial treatment resistance.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："emphasized that" = 专家指导性强调动词；"even if" = 让步条件（即使改善也要...）。② 核心规律：CET6 专家建议 + 原因：应做 X（even if 让步）+ to prevent Y（原因）= 两部分均重要。③ 验证与迁移：答案双重：complete the full course（建议）+ prevent resistance（原因）；缺少原因的选项不完整。
tips: even if + adverse condition = 让步条件，后主句动作仍需执行，是关键叮嘱。
to prevent = 目的状语，后接建议的原因，答案中必须包含 reason。

front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断微生物学家对细菌进化速度的专业观点。

back_content.text: 结论：观点：抗生素施加的选择压力使细菌进化速率远超前抗生素时代的观测水平。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Microbiologists argue that the selective pressure exerted by antibiotics on bacterial populations drives evolutionary adaptation at a rate far exceeding what was observed in pre-antibiotic eras.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："argue that" = 专业学术立场；"far exceeding" = 程度比较，强调当前进化速率明显更快。② 核心规律：CET6 学术意见题：argue/contend/maintain that = 学者坚持的立场，答案在 that 之后。③ 验证与迁移：答案：bacteria now evolve dramatically faster due to antibiotic selection pressure；重点词：far exceeding。
tips: far exceeding = 远超，是程度比较的高频表达，答案选项应含 significantly faster/much higher rate。
argue vs. warn = 学术立场 vs. 警告，前者较中性客观，后者含规范性建议。

tips: expert consensus = 专家共识，通常比个别建议更权威，优先选。
most effectively = 最高级排他，其他合理但次要的措施 = 干扰项。

tips: cautioned that + lack = 警告缺乏依据，是对 App/工具的批评性指导。
may encourage = 可能鼓励（非确定性），是对潜在风险的委婉表达。

cross-reference = 核实比对，比 simply check 更专业准确，是专家建议类高频表达。
